q: What kind of projects does Siam Graphics take on?
a: We work across brand identity, publishing, editorial, packaging and advertising — from single logos to end-to-end magazine production and multi-city campaigns.

q: Do you work with clients outside Kolkata or India?
a: Yes. We collaborate remotely with clients across India, the US, UK and the Middle East, and deliver print production worldwide.

q: How long does a typical project take?
a: A focused identity runs 3–5 weeks. Publishing and catalogue projects typically span 6–12 weeks depending on scope and volume.

q: Can you handle printing and production too?
a: Absolutely. We manage prepress, paper selection, binding and press supervision so the final piece matches the design intent.

q: How do we start a project?
a: Send us a short brief through the contact form or WhatsApp. We reply within one business day with next steps and a tailored proposal.
